**Fix choice.** I dropped `temperature`, `top_p` and `max_tokens` from every request instead of relying only on retry-on-400. Kimi's docs say outright that these values are fixed, other values return an error, and you should not send them (https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/api/models-overview). OpenAI's GPT-5-family reasoning models also accept only the default temperature. findings.title: Recycle mode silently and permanently deletes a whole batch (or whole folder) when any path is 260 characters or longer
findings.evidence: Phase J removed FOF_WANTNUKEWARNING from RECYCLE_FLAGS. The pre-filters (RecycleBinInfo::refuse, which skip_unrecyclable at preflight.rs:450 and bin_refuse at execution both use) only check the size against MaxCapacity and the NukeOnDelete / NoRecycleFiles settings. They never check path length. I ran a temporary probe (deleted afterwards) under D:\desk\claudex\13\dw-test-delsafety, calling winops::recycle_items on single files: path lengths 240/255/258/259 gave Recycled; lengths 260/261/262 gave Deleted, with no record in D:\$Recycle.Bin. End-to-end run of action::execute with a hand-built Review-tier PlanItem, Strategy::RecycleBin, 20 short files in sub\, 1 file at a 290+ character path and 1 top-level short file: (a) dir_recycle=false printed `exec ok=22 ... by_dest permanent count 22, recycle 0` and `PERMANENTLY GONE (not in bin) = 22`. All 21 short-path files in the same 256-entry IFileOperation batch were nuked along with the long one. (b) dir_recycle=true printed `by_dest permanent 21, recycle 1`, `PERMANENTLY GONE = 21`, so the whole sub\ folder was nuked by the whole-folder recycle. (c) Control without the long file: all 21 recycled, 0 gone. Restores ran and a final check printed `OURS STILL IN BIN = 0`.
findings.failure_scenario: The user picks 回收站 (or there is no other drive, so recycle is the default for 需你判断 items). A review item (a project folder, a downloads folder, anything holding a deep node_modules or long names) contains one file whose full path is 260 characters or longer. That file's 256-entry chunk, or the whole ≤1 GB folder chosen for whole-folder recycle, is permanently deleted with no prompt. The user believes everything is in the Recycle Bin, but the files cannot be recovered. With the old flag the worker would have hung on an invisible dialog instead; now it destroys data.
findings.suggested_fix: In RecycleBinInfo::refuse / skip_unrecyclable and in execute's bin_refuse, treat any path with ≥ 259 characters (MAX_PATH including the NUL) as RecycleUnavailable ('路径太长，进不了回收站'). In dir_units / try_recycle_dir, reject any subtree whose longest descendant path is ≥ 259 characters, and recheck that against the list_tree result. As defence in depth, recycle in batches of 1 when any path in the batch is near the limit, and add a regression test that mirrors the probe above (long path plus short siblings in recycle mode must give 0 permanently deleted).

In the e2e probe the plan had only Review-tier items, yet the notes were ['可放心清理的缓存已直接删除…', '有 22 个文件回收站没收（太大或回收站已关）…']. findings.suggested_fix: Count nuked entries separately (by_dest.nuked or a reason code) instead of folding them into permanent. Gate the safe-direct note on permanent-delete successes from Tier::Safe items only. Give the nuke note a cause-neutral text, or the real cause.

findings.title: Live-Chromium-cache guard runs only at preflight; POSIX direct delete at execute will remove caches of a browser started after preflight
findings.evidence: skip_live_chromium_caches (Restart Manager query on index/data_N/the-real-index) runs once inside preflight_with. execute::permanent() opens with DELETE and full sharing, then sets FILE_DISPOSITION_FLAG_DELETE | POSIX_SEMANTICS. Chromium opens cache files with FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so the open succeeds and the name disappears immediately. There is no lock probe or Restart Manager check at execute time for the Permanent dest (the recycle path at least gets a shell failure plus delete_probe). The safe tier (Chromium caches) is exactly the tier that now goes to Permanent by default. Also, if rm_locking_processes fails, the check returns an empty list, so it fails open.
findings.failure_scenario: The user opens the confirm dialog (preflight finishes with Chrome / Edge / VS Code / WebView2 apps closed), then starts the browser and clicks 清理 minutes later. The safe-tier cache files of the now-running browser are POSIX-deleted from under it. This is the PHASE_J_CRASH 隐患 5 corruption the guard was meant to prevent.
findings.suggested_fix: Before running units, re-run skip_live_chromium_caches (or a cheap RM check of the index files) on a clone of the plan's cache directories and turn hits into Skip(Locked). Or recheck per cache-directory unit just before its first delete. Treat an RM error as 'assume live' (fail closed) for these directories.

findings.title: Whole-folder recycle verifies each file before listing, leaving a long window in which modified files (hot-window guard) are swept
findings.evidence: try_recycle_dir runs reverify() on every entry of the subtree first (the subtree is ≤ 1 GB with no cap on file count; a 1 GB tree of small files can hold 100k files, which is seconds of fingerprinting), then list_tree compares only the name set, then recycle_items([dir]) runs. A file reverified early and then written to (mtime changes, so it becomes 'hot') before the folder move is not re-detected: list_tree compares names only. There is also no cancel check inside the reverify loop, which delays 停止. A file created and removed with the same name, or an empty subdirectory replaced by a same-name file, also passes the name-set equality.
findings.failure_scenario: In a review-tier folder being recycled, an app writes to file A after A's fingerprint was checked but before the whole-folder move. The just-modified file goes to the Recycle Bin despite guardrail 4 (skip files modified within 30 minutes). Normally it is recoverable from the bin. Combined with the path-length nuke above, it is not recoverable.
findings.suggested_fix: Cap whole-folder units by file count (for example ≤ 2,000), or redo a cheap pass after list_tree comparing the directory-entry mtime/size from list_dir (which list_tree already fetches) against the fingerprints, and fall back to per-file on any difference. Check sh.cancelled() inside the reverify loop.

findings.title: Close-guard safety valve lets the process exit mid-execution without flushing the quarantine manifest
findings.evidence: After 停止 plus 20 s, CloseRequested is no longer prevented, and RunEvent::ExitRequested only prevents exit while `recreating`. When acting is true it only logs. The manifest is flushed every 10 s by the timer thread and at item finalize. Nothing flushes it on exit, so up to ~10 s of add_manifest entries for files already moved into the batch folder are lost.
findings.failure_scenario: A cross-drive stash run is stuck (for example a large CopyFileExW, or a slow whole-folder reverify). The user presses 停止, waits 20 s and closes. Files moved in the last ≤10 s sit in D:\DiskWhy暂存区\<batch> but are missing from manifest.json, so 暂存区 → 还原 cannot restore them. The interrupted banner reports a stale 'processed' count (it is also updated only every 30 s, and it includes skipped entries).
findings.suggested_fix: In ExitRequested while acting, synchronously save the current manifest (expose a handle to Shared's manifest, or write each moved file to an append-only journal next to manifest.json). Alternatively, flush the manifest after every N moves instead of on a timer.

findings.title: Elevated helper's icacls follows reparse points and has a check-then-use race; helper accepts any SID and user-writable roots
findings.evidence: elevated_mkdir_from_args checks plain_dir(q) (symlink_metadata plus the REPARSE_POINT attribute) and then runs `icacls <q> /grant *SID:(OI)(CI)M` as administrator. icacls without /L acts on the target of a junction or symlink. Between the check and icacls, a same-user process that can rename X:\DiskWhy暂存区 (for example on C:\, where Authenticated Users can create root folders and own them) can swap in a junction to C:\Windows\System32. The elevated icacls then grants that user inheritable Modify there. The helper also accepts any S-1-… SID (valid_sid would accept S-1-1-0 Everyone) and any fixed drive, including roots the user can already write, where elevation is never needed.
findings.failure_scenario: Needs UAC consent for the DiskWhy binary, so this is local escalation only. Malware running as the user triggers or awaits 'diskwhy.exe --mkdir-quarantine C:\ …'. If the user approves the familiar DiskWhy UAC prompt, the junction race grants rights on a system directory.
findings.suggested_fix: Do the ACL change in-process on a handle: CreateFileW(q, WRITE_DAC|READ_CONTROL, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS), verify through GetFileInformationByHandle that it is a plain directory, then SetSecurityInfo on that handle. Or at least pass /L to icacls. Refuse when the non-elevated user can already create folders in the root, and refuse well-known group SIDs (only accept S-1-5-21-… user SIDs).

findings.title: Cancelled run still deletes the empty subfolders of unfinished items while the report says the rest was left untouched
findings.evidence: After the worker scope ends, every active item not yet finalized goes through finalize_item, which runs remove_dir on every empty directory in item.dirs, including items whose units never started because of cancel. The report note then says '已停止：还有 N 个没处理，原样没动。'
findings.failure_scenario: The user presses 停止 early. Pre-existing empty folders inside not-yet-started items are removed (logged as rmdir) even though the UI says the remaining items were left untouched. This is a minor mismatch between the on-disk state and the report.
findings.suggested_fix: When cancelled, only finalize items with at least one completed unit, or limit removal to directories that became empty during this run. Otherwise word the note so it covers removed empty folders.

findings.title: Quarantine manifest only reaches disk every 10 s; after a kill, files moved in that window are not shown and cannot be restored from the UI
findings.evidence: execute() saves an empty Manifest at start (line 378). After that, entries go only to the in-memory Mutex<Option<Manifest>> (add_manifest, line 1378). They are written to disk by the timer thread every manifest_flush_secs=10 (line 525), by finalize_item, and at the end (line 613). quarantine::list_batches skips any batch with no 'stored' entries (quarantine.rs:428-430). restore() only handles manifest entries; when every listed entry is back, it marks the batch restored, and the batch then disappears from list_batches.
findings.failure_scenario: The process is killed from outside, like the real 0x8f exit in PHASE_J_CRASH.md, during a same-volume stash running at about 5k files/s. Up to about 50k files are already renamed into <root>\DiskWhy暂存区\<batch>\ but are not in manifest.json. If the kill comes before the first 10 s flush, the manifest is still empty, so list_batches hides the whole batch and every moved file is stranded. Otherwise the batch shows only the flushed part. After Restore, the batch disappears and the unrecorded files stay on that drive with nothing pointing to them. The interrupted banner does not say any files were left in the stash. The other copy of the actions.log line is also lost, because the 64 KB log buffer is flushed only every 200 ms.
findings.suggested_fix: Write each stored entry to an append-only journal (manifest.jsonl, opened once, appended per entry or per 256-entry chunk) and rebuild the manifest from it on load. Or flush after each chunk instead of each 10 s. Also let list_batches / restore find files under the batch dir that are not in the manifest and show them.

findings.title: The app's own ✕ can never use the 20 s close safety valve, so a hung execution leaves the window unclosable from inside the app
findings.evidence: TitleBar: `else if (execPhase.value === "running") onCloseBlocked(); else await w.close();`. While the frontend is running, it never sends a close request, so close_should_block's CLOSE_GUARD_GIVE_UP_SECS branch (lib.rs:961-969) is reached only through Alt+F4 or the taskbar. Once stopping, ConfirmDialog shows only the '正在停止' spinner. The '先停止再关' hint and the nudged 停止 button are in the v-else branch (ConfirmDialog.vue:381-389), so a click on ✕ shows nothing. restore_batch and purge_batch hold `acting` with no cancel, so cancel_at is never set and the valve can never fire for them, not even through Alt+F4.
findings.failure_scenario: A worker hangs inside IFileOperation or a CopyFileExW on a dying disk. The user presses 停止 and waits more than 20 s, then clicks ✕ repeatedly. Nothing happens and nothing appears on screen. This non-technical user has no way to close the app except Task Manager, which is the same 'program vanished, no summary' situation phase J was meant to fix. A hung restore or purge cannot be closed at all.
findings.suggested_fix: In TitleBar, when execStopping is true (or always), call w.close() and let the backend decide: it emits close-blocked, or lets the close through after the valve. Show a stopping-state hint. Give restore and purge their own valve, or arm cancel_at when a close is blocked while acting and no exec_cancel exists.

findings.title: '上次清理中断 · 已处理 N 个' comes from last-run.json, which is updated only every 30 s, so N can be hundreds of thousands too low
findings.evidence: run_state('running') is saved at start with processed=0 (line 489) and then only in the heartbeat branch every heartbeat_secs=30 (lines 515-524). runstate::interrupted returns s.processed unchanged, and interruptedLine shows it. The benchmark says direct delete runs at about 16.7k files/s.
findings.failure_scenario: The app is killed 25 s into a direct-delete run, before the first heartbeat. Next launch shows '上次清理中断 · 已处理 0 个' even though about 400k files were deleted. Even after heartbeats, the count can be 30 s stale, up to about 500k files at direct-delete speed. This is the number phase J added to tell the user how much really happened.
findings.suggested_fix: Update last-run.json on the progress tick every 1–2 s (it is tiny and written atomically by tmp+rename). Or count the batch's ok and skipped lines in actions.log on next launch, which the start/batch_begin records already make possible.

findings.title: exec_progress / last_exec_report return an earlier execution's data during a restore or purge, so attachExec shows a fake cleaning run and an old completion page
findings.evidence: exec_progress returns state.exec_progress whenever `acting` is true (lines 783-788). That field is cleared only at the start of execute_plan (line 715) and never when it ends. restore_batch and purge_batch also set acting. attachExec (store.ts) treats any non-null exec_progress as a live execution: it sets execPhase='running', and when acting drops it calls lastExecReport(), which still returns the earlier report, and shows it with execPhase='done'.
findings.failure_scenario: In one session the user cleans, then starts a stash restore. During the restore the WebView2 browser process dies and the window is rebuilt, or the renderer reloads. init() → actionStatus() true → attachExec. The modal '正在清理' appears frozen at the old run's final bytes and percentage. When the restore finishes, it shows the old run's '清理完成 · C 盘多出 X GB' as if it had just happened.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear exec_progress, or tag it with the batch or an 'exec running' flag, when execute_plan finishes. Have exec_progress return None unless an execution (not a restore or purge) is in progress, for example by keeping an enum of the current action instead of a bare `acting` bool.

findings.title: The timer thread saves the full manifest synchronously, which stalls progress, log flushing and the cancel signal; concurrent saves can also write an older snapshot over a newer one
findings.evidence: On the 200 ms progress thread, save_manifest clones the whole Manifest under the manifest lock (line 309), which blocks every worker's add_manifest. It then serializes and writes the full JSON (quarantine.rs:87-93; their own comment says about 80 MB at 200k entries) every 10 s and again in each finalize_item. While this runs, the thread emits no progress, does not flush the log, sends no heartbeat, and does not forward cancel to cancel_i32. save_manifest clones before taking manifest_io, so timer and finalizer can each clone, the newer one writes first, and then the older one overwrites it.
findings.failure_scenario: A same-volume stash of 300k files. Every 10 s the progress bar and '剩约' freeze for about 1–2 s, the rate window gets distorted, the log buffer stays unflushed longer (more is lost on a kill), and the total manifest I/O grows quadratically (GBs written). With the ordering race, a crash right after an older snapshot overwrote a newer one loses more entries than 10 s' worth.
findings.suggested_fix: Take manifest_io before cloning so saves are ordered, or keep a version counter and skip stale writes. Move the manifest save to its own thread, or use an append-only journal so the save is O(new entries).

findings.title: Perf learning counts the full file size as copied even for skipped, failed and cancelled cross-volume entries; a cancelled run then permanently skews est_secs
findings.evidence: After every Quarantine entry, whatever the outcome (reverify skip, hardlink skip, copy_cancelled, failed), run_files does `meas.xvol.0 += 1; meas.xvol.1 += ms(t); meas.xvol.2 += e.size` (lines 1134-1137). execute() calls model.learn() even when cancelled (line 732). learn() derives one k = actual/pred for every op and moves xvol_mb_s by /k once xvol_bytes ≥ 64 MB (perf.rs:238-266). The post-cancel serial finalize_item list_dir sweep (line 578) adds wall time that the model does not include.
findings.failure_scenario: The user stops a cross-drive stash 1 s into a 4 GB file. pred ≈ 27 s, actual ≈ 1 s, so k is clamped to 0.2. xvol_mb_s goes from 150 to about 330, and every op type with ≥200 samples drops to ×0.76. The next confirm dialog's '约 N 分钟' is far too short. If the stop instead lands while finalize scans thousands of non-empty dirs, k goes up and the estimate gets inflated.
findings.suggested_fix: Count xvol bytes only for successful copies (and partial bytes from the CopyFileExW progress routine if wanted). Skip learn() when cancelled, or learn only from the per-op busy times in Measured instead of one wall-clock k.

findings.title: A panic in a worker is swallowed: its unit is reported as 'not processed / 原样没动' even though files in it may already be deleted, with cancelled=false
findings.evidence: Worker handles are joined with `let _ = h.join();` (lines 561-563), and the panic hook only logs (crash.rs:150-169; release profile uses unwind). The panicked unit's parts[u] stays None, so the merge step runs account_untouched on it (lines 569-576). That records every Delete entry as not_processed and writes a 'cancel' log line saying '已停止：… 原样没动'. remaining[item] never reaches 0, so the main thread finalizes that item. Nothing in rep.notes mentions it.
findings.failure_scenario: A shell extension or a bug panics a worker halfway through a 256-entry recycle chunk after 200 files were already recycled. The done page shows '没处理 256 个', the log claims they were untouched, and the title says 清理完成, not 已停止. The user is told files are still in place when they are actually in the Recycle Bin or deleted.
findings.suggested_fix: Check h.join() results. On Err, add a note to the report ('一个线程出错，这一块的结果不确定，请看日志'), log a distinct op (not 'cancel'), and account that unit as 'unknown', not 'untouched'. Or wrap run_unit in catch_unwind and keep the Part built so far.

findings.title: If the first worker cannot be spawned, execute() hangs forever because thread::scope waits on the timer thread
findings.evidence: Inside std::thread::scope, `Err(e) => panic!("起不了工作线程：{e}")` runs when handles is empty (line 558). On a closure panic, std::thread::scope still waits for all spawned threads before propagating it. The timer thread loops `while !all_done_r.load(..)`, and all_done is set only after the joins (line 564), which this path never reaches.
findings.failure_scenario: Thread creation fails, for example under address-space or commit pressure on the 8 MB stack request. execute_plan never returns, `acting` stays true forever, close is blocked with no cancel_at (the cancel flag does nothing because no worker is running), and the UI sits at 0% indefinitely.
findings.suggested_fix: Set all_done before panicking, or return an Err instead of panicking; for example, compute the worker handles first and set all_done in a drop guard inside the scope closure.

findings.title: Whole-folder recycle that fails partway falls back to per-file processing, which mislabels files already in the Recycle Bin as 'skipped · 已经不在了'
findings.evidence: try_recycle_dir returns false on any non-Recycled/Deleted outcome (`_ => return false`, line 1276). recycle_items reports the folder as Failed if the folder path still exists (winops.rs:627-631), even if IFileOperation already moved part of the subtree. run_unit then calls run_files on the same entries (line 818). For moved files reverify gets ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND → SkipReason::Missing.
findings.failure_scenario: A whole-folder recycle where one file got locked after verification. The shell recycles some children and then stops, so the folder remains and the result is Failed. Per-file fallback counts the already-recycled files as skipped/missing. by_dest.recycle and '回收站 X GB' are too low, '跳过 · 已经不在了' is too high, and the log has no recycle record for files that really are in the bin. Unverified: depends on whether the shell recycles a folder partially or all-or-nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: After a failed whole-folder recycle, check which entries vanished and treat those as Recycled (the PostDeleteItem sink already reports per-item results), or log them as 'recycled (dir partial)' instead of falling through to Missing.

findings.title: Stop still deletes pre-existing empty subfolders in items it never touched, and does it as a long serial sweep after the stop
findings.evidence: After the scope, every active item not yet finalized goes through finalize_item on the main thread (lines 578-583). That includes items whose units were never started because of the cancel. finalize_item list_dir's every entry in item.dirs and removes any that are empty (lines 1314-1345), including folders that were empty before the run. The real run had 23,752 rmdir records, so this sweep can be tens of thousands of list_dir calls on one thread after 停止.
findings.failure_scenario: The user presses 停止 early. The dialog keeps showing '正在停止' for many seconds while the main thread walks every directory of every item. The run also removes empty folders in items that '原样没动' was supposed to leave alone. dirs_removed counts them, and they are not shown as not_processed.
findings.suggested_fix: On cancel, finalize only items that had at least one unit run (track a per-item 'started' flag). Leave the others alone, as promised.

findings.title: After execute returns, the post-run refresh holds `acting` with exec_cancel/cancel_at reset, so close is blocked again with no valve and 停止 is a no-op
findings.evidence: execute_plan sets exec_cancel=None and cancel_at=None (lines 746-747), then runs refresh_after (rescans plus a full-tree analyze) while the Acting guard is still alive. close_should_block then returns true with cancel_at=None, and cancel_execute returns false. The frontend still shows execPhase='running' with a 停止 button, and stopExec leaves execStopping=true.
findings.failure_scenario: After a large run, the refresh on a 1M-file C: tree takes several seconds. The user presses 停止, which shows '正在停止' and does nothing, and ✕ or Alt+F4 are blocked even if the 20 s valve had already been armed during the run. Annoying and confusing rather than harmful.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop `acting`, or switch to a non-blocking 'refreshing' state, before refresh_after. Or keep cancel_at armed and send a final progress event telling the UI the work is done (execPhase='done' before the refresh).

findings.title: dismiss_interrupted can mark the live run's last-run.json 'dismissed', hiding a real interruption
findings.evidence: dismiss() flips any status=='running' file to 'dismissed' without checking pid or batch (lines 165-174). execute() rewrites 'running' only on the next heartbeat, up to 30 s later. The command is callable while acting.
findings.failure_scenario: The interrupted banner was loaded at startup. The user starts a new clean, and a dismiss call (stale UI or a click that lands in the gap) flips the new run to 'dismissed'. If the app is killed before the next heartbeat, the next launch reports nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Have dismiss take the batch id from the Interrupted it is dismissing and only flip that batch. Or refuse when s.pid is a live DiskWhy, or while acting.

findings.title: freed_bytes ('C 盘多出') picks up other activity on the volume, including Windows purging old Recycle Bin items
findings.evidence: freed_bytes = Σ max(0, free_after − free_before) over the source volumes (lines 617-624), measured across the whole run (27 min in the real incident). Preflight lets recycle runs go ahead over MaxCapacity with only a warning (preflight.rs:899-912). When the bin goes over its limit, Windows silently deletes the oldest items, which frees space the run did not delete.
findings.failure_scenario: A recycle run over the bin limit. Windows purges 3 GB of the user's old deleted files, so the done page says 'C 盘多出 3.0 GB' next to '回收站 5 GB · 还没腾出'. That reads as a contradiction and hides that old items were permanently removed. Long runs also absorb browser cache or Windows Update writes, so the big number can be well below what was deleted.
findings.suggested_fix: By design (§3.5), but clamp or annotate it: if freed_bytes > by_dest.permanent + cross-volume quarantine bytes + a slack, add a note ('回收站超上限，Windows 清掉了更早的东西'). If freed is much smaller than the expected bytes, show the expected value on hover.

findings.title: Pressing 停止 after the last file finishes still reports '已停止' with 0 not processed
findings.evidence: cancelled = opts.cancel.load() is read after all work and finalization (line 584), not 'some work was actually left'. Notes then add '已停止：还有 0 个没处理' and run_state is saved as 'cancelled'.
findings.failure_scenario: The user clicks 停止 just as the bar reaches 100%. The done page title is 已停止 even though everything completed, and the note says 0 not processed.
findings.suggested_fix: Set cancelled = flag && (not_processed.count > 0 || any unit never started).

findings.title: The 改放 D 盘 chip deletes files outright instead of moving them to D
findings.evidence: I ran this in the dev server with Playwright and Edge. I opened the dialog with only 可放心清理 items and picked 回收站 from the menu, so the line read '可放心清理 进回收站'. The row '回收站在 C 盘，不腾空间 [改放 D 盘]' was shown. After clicking 改放 D 盘 the line read '可放心清理 直接删' and the free-space text went to 'C 盘剩余 14.0 → 37.1 GB'. Nothing goes to D. Cause: pick('stash') makes currentPlanArgs return safeDirect=true, and safe items never go to the stash. The real-exe screenshot phaseJ-F1-exe-recycle-C.png shows this exact chip on a plan with only safe items.
findings.failure_scenario: The user picks 回收站 because they want to be able to undo. They see 回收站在 C 盘，不腾空间 and click 改放 D 盘, expecting the files to be kept on D. Instead the files are deleted permanently with no undo. The button says one thing and does another on a destructive action.
findings.suggested_fix: Only show 改放 D 盘 when the plan has 需你判断 items (hasReview). For a safe-only plan, label the chip 直接删 (what it actually does), or keep safeDirect=false when moving away from an explicit 回收站 choice.

findings.title: Clicking the text 我知道这些删了的后果 does nothing because the checkbox toggles twice
findings.evidence: The markup is . A button counts as a label's control in HTML, so clicking the span runs its handler and then the label sends a click to the button, which toggles again. Playwright output: 'ack initial false', 'after click label text false', 'after click box true', 'after click count text false'. The bug already existed on master but it is in the dialog this phase rewrote. This checkbox is the only thing that unlocks the main button whenever 需你判断 items are present.
findings.failure_scenario: A non-technical user clicks the words 我知道这些删了的后果, as most people do. The box stays empty and the 清理 button stays grey, so the dialog looks broken. Clicking the gray 2 项需你判断 text, by contrast, does toggle it.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove @click from the span and let the label do the toggle, or change <label> to a <div>. A cleaner option is one <button role=checkbox> that contains the text.

findings.title: The dialog backdrop covers the title bar, so the window cannot be minimized or moved during a long cleanup
findings.evidence: .scrim is position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:80 inside .app, and the TitleBar has z-index 40. With the dialog open, document.elementFromPoint(1325,21), the minimize button at 1440x900, returns DIV.scrim. Every F1 screenshot shows the min/max/close buttons dimmed under the backdrop. The dialog estimates '约 13 分钟' for the user's real case.
findings.failure_scenario: During a 10+ minute cleanup the user cannot minimize DiskWhy or drag it out of the way with the mouse. The title-bar ✕ handling added in TitleBar.vue also cannot be reached by mouse. Only Alt+F4 or the taskbar work.
findings.suggested_fix: Start the backdrop below the title bar (top: var(--titlebar)), or raise the title bar above it and keep only the ✕ blocked while cleaning. The 先停止再关 nudge already covers ✕.

findings.title: Keyboard focus is not kept inside the dialog; Tab+Enter can start a new preview while a cleanup is running
findings.evidence: Playwright, with run=hold: Tab moves focus from 停止 to the title bar and page controls behind the dialog. After 30 Tabs it reached the cleanup page's 'btn|清理 28.3 GB'. Pressing Enter changed dialogSeq from 1 to 2 while execPhase stayed 'running' and a new report appeared. In the real backend, preview_plan (src-tauri/src/lib.rs:564) does not check whether a cleanup is running: it clears state.plan and runs a full file-by-file check alongside the cleanup. The dialog also has no Escape handler in any state, and focus is not moved into it when it opens.
findings.failure_scenario: A keyboard user, or a stray Enter on a focused page button, starts a second heavy preflight during execution. The dialog is remounted, so its progress and rate samples reset. Keyboard users also cannot close the confirm step with Esc.
findings.suggested_fix: While the dialog is open, make the page and title bar inert (the inert attribute) or trap focus, and move focus into the dialog when it opens. Have Esc call close(); close() already ignores the running state. Also disable the cleanup page's 清理 button while execPhase !== 'idle', and have preview_plan refuse while a cleanup is running.

findings.title: The done page shows an orange '注意 N 条' on almost every run, and its tooltip still says 隔离区
findings.evidence:
execute.rs:694-706 always adds notes: '可放心清理的缓存已直接删除…' whenever anything is deleted directly, '文件在回收站里…', and '隔离区保留 7 天（不会自动删），可以在“隔离区”里…'. ConfirmDialog shows them as
注意 {{ notes.length }} 条
in --review-label orange. The mock always returns notes: [], so no F1 screenshot shows this. I added real-shaped notes through the store and the done page showed '注意 2 条', with the tooltip containing '隔离区' twice.
findings.failure_scenario: Every successful cleanup ends with a warning-colored 注意 line, which suggests something went wrong when nothing did. Hovering it shows the old 隔离区 name, against decision §3.8 (暂存区 everywhere).
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the routine notes; the rows already say 直接删除 and 回收站 · 还没腾出. Show the line only for real problems (nuked files, manifest error). Rename 隔离区 to 暂存区 in the backend note and warning strings.

findings.title: After scanning D:, the default 暂存区 is put on C:, the nearly full system drive
findings.evidence: stashDrives = every fixed drive except the source drive. pickDefaultDest only requires free > need + 64 MB. Playwright: after switching to D (summary.root = 'D:\\') and opening the dialog with a 需你判断 item, the destination line read '可放心清理 直接删 · 需你判断 暂存到 C 盘'.
findings.failure_scenario: On the user's machine C: has about 7 GB free. Cleaning 5 GB of 需你判断 items on D would by default fill C to about 2 GB free, making the exact problem the app exists to fix worse.
findings.suggested_fix: Never pick the system drive (or any drive under 10–15% free) as the default 暂存区. Fall back to 回收站 on the source drive, or keep it only as an explicit menu choice.

findings.title: With only 可放心清理 items, the destination menu shows D 盘暂存区 as selected, and choosing it changes nothing
findings.evidence: Playwright with modal=1 and no 需你判断 items: the line read '可放心清理 直接删' while the menu's checked entry was 'D 盘暂存区 剩 43.0 GB'. Clicking D 盘暂存区 left the line at '可放心清理 直接删'. Only 回收站 has any effect on safe items.
findings.failure_scenario: The user thinks the files will be kept in D 盘暂存区 because it is ticked, but they are deleted directly. Picking 直接删除 or a stash drive is a no-op.
